The '''Fallex Crisis''' was a battle between the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] and the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]] on the [[Planet/Legends|Planet]] [[Fallex]]. The battle ended when the Rebels overthrew the [[Unidentified governor|local governor]]. As a thanks, the Fallex natives offered their planet's resources to the Rebel Alliance.

*''[[Onslaught at Arda I]]'' {{1stm}}
